import Base

# Missing entries are the dead halo surrounding each finite row.
def head0(xs: List<&2, U32>) -> U32:
  Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, xs), 0)

# The middle row supplies the shape; the other rows supply vertical mass.
def columns(
  middle: List<&2, U32>, +above: List<&2, U32>, +below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match middle:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{cell, rest}:
      (head0(above) + cell + head0(below) : U32) <>
        columns(rest, List.tail(&2, U32, above), List.tail(&2, U32, below))

# Counting the center turns B3/S23 into total=3 or (alive and total=4).
def sweep(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +mass: List<&2, U32>, left: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{cell, rest}:
      +center = head0(mass)
      +right = List.tail(&2, U32, mass)
      +total = (left + center + head0(right) : U32)
      next = Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(total, 4))))
      next <> sweep(rest, right, center)

# Advance an immutable three-row window; only completed output is appended.
def rows(
  remaining: Nat, +width: Nat,
  above: List<&2, U32>, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match remaining:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      +middle = List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
      +below = List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width)
      mass = columns(middle, above, List.take(&2, U32, below, width))
      List.append(&2, U32, sweep(middle, mass, 0),
        rows(rest, width, middle, below))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  rows(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), Nil{}, cells)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
